comment: Single source of model constants, shared by the data pipeline (Python) and the app engine (JavaScript). Edit here, never inline.

non_knockout_model.comment: Pick rule for pool and stage-2 matches (the ones that can be drawn). Layered on top of match_model, which still produces the probabilities. Knockouts are untouched. mode 'validated' is the only mode ever published; 'tournament' adds switches fitted to matches already played and exists as a benchmark — see scripts/model_non_knockout.py.

tournament_mode.comment: Fitted to played outcomes; rejected for generalisation. Never used for a published pick.
